summary: Phibro Animal Health Corporation filed a Form 8-K to report the declaration of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share on Class A and Class B common stock, payable September 23, 2026, to stockholders of record September 2, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation such as an extraordinary capital return, tender offer, or restructuring. No unusual terms, strategic actions, or corporate events are involved. The filing serves as standard disclosure of recurring shareholder remuneration, with no special structural or risk-arbitrage considerations.
